claims.title: Complete prime-local reciprocal Fable fibre
claims.proof: corrected/core.tex, section The complete local algebra distinguishes E from M; cumulative crosswalk EZ28a-EZ28k
claims.statement: For every original p=1 mod 4 E or M state, the reciprocal-cubic target has seven reduced geometric affine inverse points and exactly three Q_p-points. Its algebra is Q_p^3 times two isomorphic ramified quadratic fields in E and Q_p^3 times two copies of the unique unramified quadratic field in M.

claims.title: Exact root-order conductor and interpolation loss
claims.statement: The E root order is {(z1,z2,z3) in Z_p^3 : z1=z2 mod p}, of index p and conductor pZ_p x pZ_p x Z_p; the M root order is Z_p^3. The labelled E-to-M interpolation has coefficient valuations (0,-1,-1), while the reverse interpolation is integral.

claims.title: Negative-four-square same-prime channel transfer
claims.proof: corrected/core.tex, section An unbounded family of exact same-prime channel returns; cumulative crosswalk EZ28r-EZ28z
claims.statement: An existing E state with alpha=-4c^2 or beta=-4c^2 and c dividing (h+1)/4 supplies an explicit original same-prime M state. The complete alpha inverse fibre includes the necessary and sufficient original gate R_s | 4hr^2+1; the beta inverse fibre is the displayed discriminant-square fibre. Every existing source on alpha=-4 or beta=-4 returns, without asserting existence or infinitude of sources on those lines.

claims.title: Complete fixed-cofactor middle fibre
claims.statement: For an existing E state with h=3 mod 4 and j=(h+1)/4, the divisors U of j^2 satisfying h | p+4U are in bijection with all original M states at p having normalized cofactor Q=h. The exact formulas recover every coordinate and denominator. This strictly extends the selected negative-square words, reduces the proved residual exterior source to radius at least nine, gives an explicit return at p=41161 where c does not divide j, and retains an empty fixed-Q example at p=3049.

corrections.replacement: The roots have distinct reductions and all derivative values are units; derivative residues need not be pairwise distinct.
corrections.counterexample: p=5, state (a,u,R,h,r,s,lambda,H)=(2,1,3,1,1,2,1,2), root residues (0,3,1), derivative residues (3,1,3).

nonclaims: The fibre classification starts from an existing arithmetic state and does not prove universal ES occupancy.
Equal rational point counts do not identify the E and M local algebras.
The integral root-order conductor is not the fixed complex weighted analytic conductor.
No p-adic descent of the complex period matrix, zeta-zero theorem, or whole-package Lean formalization is claimed.
